## About
Plumber XP, Inc. is a family-owned and operated plumbing company based in La Habra. What started with a van and a big vision has grown into a full team of skilled professionals committed to honest work and lasting results.
We treat every home like it's our own. That means showing up on time, doing the job right the first time, and keeping you in the loop from the first call to the cleanup. No hassle, no surprises, just plumbing done right.
Our customers aren't just jobs. They're neighbors and friends. That's how we've earned a 5 rating on Google from 306 reviews.

## Services
- Plumbing Repair: From minor faucet leaks to complete house re-pipes, we cover it all.
- Water Heater: Repair or replace your traditional water heater, or go tankless.
- Drain Cleaning: From kitchen sinks to main sewage blockages, we clear clogged drains with professional tools and techniques.
- Sewer Repair: We fix broken or damaged sewer lines with traditional or trenchless solutions.
- Sewer Sleeve / Relining: Got roots? We reinforce aging pipes from the inside with no-dig relining.
- Trenchless Pipe Installation: New underground pipes without digging up your yard or driveway.
- Drain Video Inspection: A drain camera shows us the root of the problem fast.
- Hydro-Jetting: High-pressure water jets that blast away buildup and blockages.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes. Our estimates are free, and we keep our pricing upfront and transparent.

Q: What are your weekday hours?
A: Monday-Friday, 24 hrs.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in La Habra and serve Whittier, Brea, La Habra Heights, Buena Park, La Mirada, Fullerton and Hacienda Heights.

Q: Can you fix a sewer line with roots in it?
A: We can sleeve your existing sewer pipes using relining technology. Give us a call and ask us how.
